title: Do Sharks Really Need to Swim Forever?

scenes.text: Great white sharks can hold their breath for 2 minutes without moving.
People think sharks must keep swimming or they'll die.
scenes.label: Sharks die if they stop

scenes.text: Only a few shark species need constant motion; most can rest on the sea floor and pump water over their gills.
scenes.label: Only some sharks need motion

scenes.text: Most sharks can actually rest still.
scenes.label: Sharks Rest Too
scenes.sub: They just need water flow for oxygen.

scenes.text: Hit follow for your daily dose of wow.

description: You’ll be shocked to learn that the endless‑swim myth only applies to a handful of sharks. Dive deeper with us!
